chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan, from Zur‘ah, from Samā‘ah, who said:

He said: If a man becomes forgetful concerning the first two rak‘ahs of al-Ẓuhr, al-‘Aṣr, and al-‘Atamah, and he does not know whether he has prayed one or two, then he must repeat the salat (prayer).

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ: the first two rak‘ahs of the prayer
key_terms.سَهَا: became forgetful or doubtful during prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they doubt the number of rak‘ahs in the first two units of al-Ẓuhr, al-‘Aṣr, or al-‘Atamah prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt in the first two rak‘ahs of certain four-rak‘ah prayers. If a person does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two in the first two rak‘ahs of al-Ẓuhr, al-‘Aṣr, or al-‘Atamah, he must repeat the salat (prayer).
